findings.issue: The app ships with zero tests: no test files, no test script, no runner among dependencies.
findings.suggestion: Add @nuxt/test-utils or vitest and cover at minimum the pure helpers in lib/pokeapi.ts before touching the data layer.

findings.issue: buildIndex and speciesCardsForRefs (:217) perform the riskiest transformations (type-slot dedup/order, generation membership, alternate-form exclusion, dex sort) with no regression guard.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test against small fixture payloads: multi-slot types, forms with ID > 10000, duplicate refs, species missing from the index.

findings.issue: Filtering, 48-per-page slicing, page clamping (:41), URL default omission in buildQuery (:44) and the 200 ms debounce watcher (:59) are untested; URL-state regressions (e.g. page not reset on filter change, empty params not omitted) would slip through.
findings.suggestion: Test the filter/pagination computations as pure functions or extract them to a composable with tests covering query round-tripping.

findings.issue: Sort comparator handles missing-values-last in both directions and numeric-vs-string comparison — easy to break silently, no tests.
findings.suggestion: Mount-test or extract the comparator and test: nulls last asc and desc, numeric columns, English-name string columns, aria-sort toggling.

findings.issue: The cache stores the in-flight promise, so a rejected fetch (network hiccup, 5xx) is cached forever in getIndex (:147) and getTypes too; no error-path test would catch this.
findings.suggestion: On rejection, evict the cache entry (or cache the resolved value); add a test for retry-after-failure and 404-returns-null behaviour.

findings.issue: load() encodes many spec rules (default game = highest order, ?game validation, METHOD_ORDER then alphabetical, stat Total, ÷10 conversions) with no tests.
findings.suggestion: Fixture-based test of load()'s output for a Pokémon with branching evolutions, hidden ability and multi-version-group moves.

findings.issue: Not-found paths (api null on 404, server setResponseStatus, catch-all route) are untested.
findings.suggestion: Add tests asserting 404 status and the NotFound rendering for an unknown species, move, ability and arbitrary slug.

findings.issue: Species-card mapping is reimplemented inline instead of reusing speciesCardsForRefs (pokeapi.ts:217), so the two paths can diverge without any test noticing.
findings.suggestion: Reuse speciesCardsForRefs (adding the hidden flag) or extract shared mapping covered by one test suite.

findings.issue: Env-override and trailing-slash handling of the API base is untested; a regression breaks every fetch.
findings.suggestion: One-line unit tests for trailing-slash stripping and API_BASE_URL precedence.

summary: The app contains no tests of its own — no runner, no scripts, nothing — while nearly all of its logic is exactly the kind (data-layer transforms, filtering/pagination/URL state, table sorting, 404 and failure paths) that needs them. The most valuable first step is unit coverage of lib/pokeapi.ts and the index-page filter logic, which are pure and cheap to test. A latent promise-caching bug (rejected fetches cached forever) shows concretely what the absence of error-path tests lets through.
